seoDescription: Explore the power of Payload CMS's code-based access control, which transforms it from a headless CMS into a robust application framework. This overview demonstrates how to implement granular, role-based permissions, including multi-tenant setups where users only see content for specific sites. Learn to leverage query constraints and field-level access control to dynamically secure your APIs and tailor the admin panel experience, hiding or showing fields and documents based on user roles and permissions.

chapters.title: Introduction to Payload's Access Control
chapters.description: This chapter introduces Payload's code-based access control, highlighting its power, flexibility, and dynamic impact on the admin UI.

chapters.title: Setting Up the Demo Environment
chapters.description: This chapter covers pulling the demo repository, running the dev server with a seed script, and gives a high-level overview of the collections.

chapters.title: User Collection Access Control
chapters.description: This chapter provides a deep dive into the Users collection's access control, explaining permissions and the `isAdmin` helper function.

chapters.title: Admin vs. Editor User Experience
chapters.description: This chapter demonstrates how the admin UI dynamically changes based on whether an admin or a non-admin editor is logged in.

chapters.title: Multi-Tenant Site Access Control
chapters.description: This chapter details how to implement a multi-tenant system by linking users to sites and using access control to filter collections.

chapters.title: Advanced Access: Published vs. Draft Content
chapters.description: This chapter covers a complex access control function that differentiates access for admins, editors, and unauthenticated users.

chapters.title: Public Create Access for Form Submissions
chapters.description: This chapter explains how to open up create permissions for unauthenticated users, useful for contact forms, while keeping other operations secure.

chapters.title: Conclusion and Resources
chapters.description: This chapter concludes the overview, summarizing the power of Payload's access control and pointing viewers to the companion GitHub repository.
